domain_claim: Compile-time Choose lowering enforces fanout limit (<=64 branches), rejects empty branch tables without otherwise, rejects non-empty branch bodies, resolves canonical otherwise labels to step indices, records condition slots, and lowers branch targets.
model_boundary: Pure compile-time core: vb_compile crate. No I/O, no time, no storage. TLA+ model: verification/tla/ChooseSlotLowering.tla (bounded at FanoutLimit=1, MaxInputBranches=2, MaxSlots=1).
notes: Kani preferred for bounded exhaustivity. Proptest alternative for label-resolution edge cases. Fanout limit of 64 is within Kani unwind limits. Cross-crate harness NOT needed (target is in vb_compile only).

domain_claim: Runtime ChooseSlot replay selects the first true branch, falls back to otherwise when all branches are false, and errors when no branch matches and no otherwise target exists.
model_boundary: Pure core: vb_core crate, replay/choose.rs. Deterministic branch iteration over Vec<SlotBranch>. No I/O or storage. TLA+ model: verification/tla/ChooseSlotReplay.tla (31,296 states, depth 4).
notes: Kani harness must cover: true-branch selection, false fallthrough, otherwise target, no-match error, non-boolean condition error, and slot-not-available error. Branch count bounded by compile-time limit of 64; unwind at 65.

domain_claim: Ask-answer lifecycle: pending ask timer must exist before answer; AskScheduled journal append must succeed before pending_timers insertion; SlotWritten journaled before AskAnswered; per-run journal sequence monotonicity preserved.
model_boundary: Imperative shell: vb_runtime crate, shard/lifecycle/chunk_002.rs and shard/transitions.rs. Journal append is stubbable (return synthetic Ok/Err). TLA+ model: specs/AskAnswerLifecycle.tla (1,821,659 states, depth 14).
notes: CRITICAL: append-before-insert ordering must be verified (HZ-REF-001, HZ-UNSOUND-002). Journal stub must return both Ok and Err nondeterministically. Flux refinement alternative could express SlotWritten-before-AskAnswered as a refinement type. Two target functions: await_timer and handle_ask_answer.

domain_claim: Retryable failures eventually exhaust under weak fairness; no retry occurs after max_attempts; exhausted retries remain typed and terminal; attempt counter is monotonic and overflow fail-closed.
model_boundary: Imperative shell: vb_runtime crate, shard/helpers.rs record_retry_attempt. Pre-existing Kani harness at kani_shard_lifecycle_harnesses.rs:315-354 (monotonicity only, PARTIAL). TLA+ model: specs/RetryFSM.tla (10,713 states, depth 15).
notes: Existing harness covers: monotonicity, capacity bounds, overflow fail-closed. Missing: exhaustion (Ok(false) when attempt >= max_attempts), terminal typing (error kind after exhaustion), and convergence (repeated calls stabilize). Weak-fairness liveness stays in TLA+ (HZ-TEMP-001). Extend existing file, do not create new one.

domain_claim: Journal duplicate identity by (run, seq) storage key: run_event_key produces injective encoding; append_unpersisted rejects duplicate keys; append_queued_unpersisted allows exact idempotent duplicates only.
model_boundary: Storage boundary: vb_storage crate, journal/internal.rs and keys.rs. Uses in-memory Fjall Keyspace (mock-friendly). TLA+ model: specs/RetryJournal.tla (141 states, depth 5).
notes: Kani verifies key injectivity and duplicate-rejection logic. Proptest alternative for idempotency round-trip with postcard encoding. Must exist in vb_storage crate due to crate boundary. JournalEvent PartialEq consistency must be verified (HZ-REF-002).

domain_claim: Resume transitions preserve RuntimeState discipline: Resumed journaled before drive; journal append failure rolls back to Resumable; drive failure rolls runtime state back while preserving the durable Resumed journal event; non-Resumable states are rejected with appropriate errors.
model_boundary: Imperative shell: vb_runtime crate, shard/lifecycle/chunk_001.rs (handle_resume, append_resumed_event, restore_resumable_after_drive_failure) and shard/transitions.rs (apply). TLA+ model: specs/ResumeStateMachine.tla (6,829 states, depth 11).
notes: Must verify: RuntimeState guard (only Resumable → Resuming), append-before-drive ordering, append-failure rollback path, drive-failure rollback path (journal preserved). Journal stub must return both Ok and Err. Flux refinement could express RuntimeState FSM as refinement types.

domain_claim: Admission never acknowledges or allocates live run state before durable header persistence; RunSubmitted/RunAdmission append failures map to AdmissionHeaderPersistenceFailed and prevent live state allocation; discard_journal_sequence is called on failure paths.
model_boundary: Imperative shell: vb_runtime crate, shard/lifecycle/chunk_001.rs (handle_submit, append_admission_header_journal_event) and error/conversions.rs (admission_header_persistence_failed). TLA+ model: specs/admission_header_before_ack.tla (25 states, depth 3).
notes: Must verify: append-before-insert ordering (RunSubmitted then RunAdmission before runs.insert), append-failure error mapping (AdmissionHeaderPersistenceFailed), no live state on failure, and error conversion idempotency. Journal stub must return both Ok and Err. Error model in TLA+ is bounded compared to 13-variant Rust error taxonomy (HZ-REF-004).
